title: A/R Detail: a CSV export that fails shows one error and downloads nothing
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The report has open documents on today's date.
  • You can switch this computer's network connection off and on (for example Wi-Fi).
  • Starting screen: A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Switch the computer's network connection off.
  2. Click the ⋯ button.
  3. Click "Download (CSV)".
  4. Count the messages that show and look at the browser's downloads.
  5. Switch the network connection back on.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the computer is offline; the report stays on screen.
  • Step 2: the menu opens.
  • Step 3: the error message "We couldn't export this report. Please try again." shows.
  • Step 4: exactly one message shows, no second generic error, and nothing was downloaded.
  • Step 5: the connection is back; a new export works again.

The server-error half of the same sentence cannot be caused by hand; the developers' automated tests cover it. This case covers the lost connection.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • Story 3, Error Handling: “If an export fails for any other reason (a server error or a lost connection), nothing downloads and one error message shows: "We couldn't export this report. Please try again." This message is on these six reports only; the other reports keep theirs.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Export fails for any other reason | "We couldn't export this report. Please try again." | Error toast; nothing downloads; these six reports only”
